remote_inputs.repository_binding: URL owner/repository must match the candidate repository
remote_inputs.redirect_policy: final response must remain HTTPS on raw.githubusercontent.com

environment.other_environment_inputs: Read-only GitHub Contents API credential supplied by the parent scheduler to re-read live task/resource lease state before each write; no GitHub API write capability is used by the assessor.

task_input.note: The scheduler validates the predecessor proof. workflow_run_id plus artifact_sha256 deterministically selects the same bounded URL batch on every retry. Each completed URL result, including its domain fingerprints and SHA-256 digest, is persisted immediately in the claimed task's assessment_checkpoint using the durable task queue's Contents-Blob-SHA CAS under the live task/resource fencing proof; a retry restores completed results and fetches only incomplete or failed URLs. Legacy manual execution continues to use the persisted rotation cursor.

stdout_json.meaning: Run summary only; does not prove downstream source activation.

repository_artifacts.purpose: current batch result and ephemeral fingerprints; never committed

document_store_side_effects: For each write_document logical document, JSON storage may atomically replace the base file.
For sharded documents it may create <logical-name>.manifest.json and <logical-name>.parts-<content-digest>/part-*.jsonl.
After the new manifest becomes authoritative it may delete older <logical-name>.parts-* directories.
Temporary staging directories and temporary files may be created and removed.

protected_paths.modules/uu.conf: not read or written by this entrypoint
protected_paths.sources/domain_sources.json: not written; assessment does not activate sources

publication_policy.method: After independent artifact verification, scheduler commits only allowlisted persistent history/report paths and their manifest/shard children; it fetches and rebases onto latest main, checks live leases and protected/read-only digests, then performs a non-force push and confirms the remote main SHA.

resource_contract.lock_scope_note: Live queue is re-read before every write boundary. The three logical output leases cover base JSON, adjacent manifests, content-addressed shards, staging, atomic manifest switch and old-shard cleanup. Shared logical/production-pipeline key serializes against workflow_auto_sync. The discovered_sources predecessor is required and its full legacy or sharded content digest is checked before and after execution. Only persistent history and report are committed; runtime fingerprints remain runner-local.

execution_semantics.idempotency_key: task_id + predecessor workflow_run_id + predecessor artifact_sha256 + URL; completed URL results are immutable within the task checkpoint.
execution_semantics.retry_policy: Resume the same predecessor-bound batch from the durable task-queue checkpoint. Reuse every completed URL result; repeat network reads only for URLs not yet checkpointed or whose prior fetch failed before a result was stored.
execution_semantics.timeout_note: Task input caps each run at 20 URLs, 1 MB per URL and 10 MB aggregate. Each successful URL is checkpointed immediately by a fenced queue CAS; task/resource lease is 480 seconds to cover assessment, independent verification and fenced artifact publication.
success_predicate: stdout is exactly one parseable JSON object with all required fields.
persistent and runtime assessment documents pass schema and shard-integrity verification.
Persistent history and report are committed to main, or an independently verified no-op is recorded; runtime fingerprints remain uncommitted.
execution_semantics.independent_verifier: scripts/verify_assess_sources_artifacts.py independently checks runtime/persistent counts, fingerprints exclusion, report presence and non-activation; scheduler then publishes only the two persistent resources.
execution_semantics.repository_writes: Each successful URL result is persisted to the task's progress_checkpoint in automation/task_queue.json using atomic Blob-SHA CAS and the active task/resource fencing proof. Final persistent history and report are committed to main after independent verification; runtime fingerprints remain uncommitted.

dependency_edges.edge_semantics: The Watchdog workflow_run gate enqueues only after a successful main-branch run of the exact Shadowrocket Source Discovery (Watchdog) workflow and binds run ID, head SHA and current discovered_sources artifact digest.
dependency_edges.note: The Watchdog event gate supplies successful-run provenance; the scheduler validates producer identity, run metadata and the complete current legacy/sharded artifact digest before claim, and the assessor rechecks the predecessor digest before and after execution.
dependency_edges.input_snapshot_validation: The scheduler hashes the complete legacy/sharded discovered_sources document before and after assessment and rejects publication if it changes.
dependency_edges.scheduler_enforcement: The Watchdog supplies a successful workflow_run event proof. The scheduler validates producer identity, exact workflow name, numeric workflow run ID, full producer commit SHA, allowlisted artifact path and current complete legacy/sharded artifact digest before claim. This check is performed by scheduler.build_execution_plan before the task becomes eligible for claim.

permission_boundary.filesystem: Write only the three declared logical output resources and their document-store temporary/manifest/shard children. The durable per-URL checkpoint is task.assessment_checkpoint in automation/task_queue.json, updated by bounded Contents-Blob-SHA CAS under the active task lease and all declared resource fencing tokens. Publish only persistent assessment history and report; runtime fingerprint data remains runner-local.
permission_boundary.network: HTTPS raw.githubusercontent.com only, repository-bound URL and same-host redirect checks.
permission_boundary.github_api: Read and CAS-update the durable task queue using the scheduler-supplied token. Per-URL checkpoint mutations are restricted to the currently claimed task and require matching worker/task lease plus live resource fencing tokens; the scheduler separately publishes only allowlisted persistent artifacts via a non-force Git push. The assessor performs no other GitHub API writes.
permission_boundary.protected_config: modules/uu.conf is immutable and outside this capability's write set.
